title: PEPPER: Perception-Guided Perturbation for Robust Backdoor Defense in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2511.16830v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent studies show that text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where a trigger in the input prompt can steer generation toward harmful or unintended content. Beyond the trigger token itself, backdoor effects can spread to neighboring tokens in the text embedding space. To address this, we introduce PEPPER (PErcePtion-Guided PERturbation), a backdoor defense that rewrites the caption into a semantically distant yet visually similar caption while adding unobtrusive elements. With this strategy, PEPPER disrupts the trigger embedded in the input prompt, escapes the attacked neighborhood, and thereby achieves enhanced robustness without training or access to model weights. Experiments show that PEPPER is particularly effective against text encoder-based attacks, substantially reducing attack success while preserving generation quality. translated_title: PEPPER：面向文本到图像扩散模型鲁棒后门防御的感知引导扰动
translated_abstract: 近期研究表明，文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型容易受到后门攻击，即输入提示词中的触发器可以引导模型生成有害或非预期的内容。除了触发词元本身之外，后门效应还可能扩散到文本嵌入空间中的相邻词元。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了PEPPER（感知引导扰动），这是一种后门防御方法，它将描述文本重写为语义上相距较远但在视觉上相似的版本，同时添加不显眼的元素。通过这一策略，PEPPER破坏了嵌入在输入提示词中的触发器，逃离了被攻击的邻域，从而在无需训练或访问模型权重的情况下实现了增强的鲁棒性。实验表明，PEPPER对基于文本编码器的攻击尤为有效，在保持生成质量的同时大幅降低了攻击成功率。PEPPER还可以与任何现有防御方法结合使用，产生一致的效果。
tldr: PEPPER是一种无需训练的后门防御方法，通过将提示词重写为语义相远但视觉相似的版本并添加不显眼元素，破坏后门触发器并逃离攻击邻域，从而有效防御文本到图像扩散模型的后门攻击。
en_tdlr: PEPPER is a training-free backdoor defense that rewrites prompts into semantically distant yet visually similar captions with unobtrusive elements, disrupting backdoor triggers and escaping attacked neighborhoods to robustly defend text-to-image diffusion models.
